answer: A datacenter or proxy pool therefore cannot mint a fleet in one epoch regardless of capital it holds, because each account consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. The pearl cap is policed at intake and lotus shows the per-origin counts. At most 4 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a sable tag. That is 20 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
